breaking_changes.BC_description: Removed the chalk.hasColor() method. This method was used to check if a string contains ANSI color codes. Downstream projects using this method will encounter errors as it no longer exists in the library.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Replace chalk.hasColor(string) with the has-ansi package. Example: Before: chalk.hasColor('some string'); After: const hasAnsi = require('has-ansi'); hasAnsi('some string');

breaking_changes.BC_description: Removed the chalk.stripColor() method. This method was used to remove ANSI color codes from a string. Downstream projects using this method will encounter errors as it no longer exists in the library.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Replace chalk.stripColor(string) with the strip-ansi package. Example: Before: chalk.stripColor('some string'); After: const stripAnsi = require('strip-ansi'); stripAnsi('some string');

breaking_changes.BC_description: Removed the chalk.styles property. This property provided access to ANSI style codes. Downstream projects accessing this property will encounter errors as it no longer exists in the library.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Replace access to chalk.styles with the ansi-styles package. Example: Before: const styles = chalk.styles; After: const ansiStyles = require('ansi-styles'); const styles = ansiStyles;

breaking_changes.BC_description: Requires Node.js 4 or later. Projects using older versions of Node.js will not be compatible with this version of Chalk and may fail to run or install.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Upgrade the Node.js environment to version 4 or later. Example: Before: Running on Node.js 0.12; After: Upgrade to Node.js 4 or higher.
